prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right one depends on your industry, goals, budget, channels, and whether you need full-service creative, digital/product design, media buying, B2B, B2C, etc.

If you tell me:
- your industry (B2B or B2C),
- primary goals (brand awareness, lead gen, ecommerce growth, product launch, etc.),
- budget range and timeline,
I’ll recommend a shortlist of Kansas City agencies that fit.

If you want to start evaluating yourself, use this checklist and process:
1. Define what “success” looks like: KPIs, timeline, budget.
2. Look for agencies with relevant case studies and measurable results (not just creative awards).
3. Check third‑party reviews/directories (Clutch, Google, LinkedIn), local business press (Kansas City Business Journal), and agency awards.
4. Ask for references from clients in your industry and examples of similar campaigns.
5. Interview teams to assess strategy, reporting processes, tools, timelines, and who will do the work.
6. Compare pricing models (retainer, project, performance) and ownership of creative/assets.
7. Start with a small pilot project to test chemistry and results before committing long term.

Well‑known Kansas City agencies you may want to consider (depending on your needs): Barkley (creative and brand work) and VML/VMLY&R (digital experience and integrated work). I can assemble a fuller, tailored list if you share the details above. Which direction do you want to go?
